#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Formal, isolated benchmark for PR #360 channel-wise D-candidate decisions."""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import contextlib
import hashlib
import io
import json
import os
import platform
import resource
import subprocess
import sys
import time
import tracemalloc
from pathlib import Path
from types import SimpleNamespace
from typing import Any

import dask.array as da
import numpy as np

from wandas.core.base_frame import BaseFrame
from wandas.processing.base import _try_build_channelwise_graph
from wandas.processing.cepstral import Cepstrum, Lifter, SpectralEnvelope, SpectrogramCepstrum
from wandas.processing.effects import Fade
from wandas.processing.psychoacoustic import LoudnessZwtv, RoughnessDw, SharpnessDin
from wandas.processing.spectral import FFT, IFFT, ISTFT, NOctSynthesis, STFT, Welch
from wandas.processing.temporal import FixLength

SR = 48_000.0
OPS = (
    "fft", "ifft", "istft", "cepstrum", "lifter", "spectral_envelope",
    "spectrogram_cepstrum", "noct_synthesis", "fix_length", "fade",
    "loudness_zwtv", "roughness_dw", "sharpness_din",
)
RUN_ORDER = ("whole", "candidate", "candidate", "whole", "whole", "candidate")
WELCH_CONFIGS = (
    ("mean", "constant"), ("median", "constant"),
    ("mean", "linear"), ("median", "linear"),
)


def deterministic_signal(channels: int, samples: int, dtype: str) -> np.ndarray:
    t = np.arange(samples, dtype=np.float64) / SR
    rows = [
        (0.08 + 0.01 * c) * np.sin(2 * np.pi * (220 + 37 * c) * t)
        + 0.03 * np.cos(2 * np.pi * (997 + 11 * c) * t)
        + 0.001 * ((np.arange(samples) * (c + 3)) % 29 - 14)
        for c in range(channels)
    ]
    return np.asarray(rows, dtype=dtype)


def make_case(
    name: str,
    channels: int,
    dtype: str,
    *,
    performance: bool,
    average: str = "mean",
    detrend: str = "constant",
) -> tuple[Any, np.ndarray]:
    n = 48_000 if name in {"loudness_zwtv", "roughness_dw", "sharpness_din"} else (
        240_000 if name in {"istft", "spectrogram_cepstrum"} else 1_000_000
    )
    if not performance:
        n = 48_000 if name in {"loudness_zwtv", "roughness_dw", "sharpness_din"} else (
            24_000 if name in {"istft", "spectrogram_cepstrum"} else 65_536
        )
    x = deterministic_signal(channels, n, dtype)
    if name == "fft":
        return FFT(SR), x
    if name == "welch":
        return Welch(SR, average=average, detrend=detrend), x
    if name == "ifft":
        return IFFT(SR, n_fft=n), np.fft.rfft(x, axis=-1).astype(np.complex128)
    if name == "istft":
        stft = STFT(SR, n_fft=2048)
        return ISTFT(SR, n_fft=2048, length=n), stft._process(x)
    if name == "cepstrum":
        return Cepstrum(SR), x
    if name == "lifter":
        return Lifter(SR, cutoff=0.002), x
    if name == "spectral_envelope":
        return SpectralEnvelope(SR), Cepstrum(SR)._process(x)
    if name == "spectrogram_cepstrum":
        stft = STFT(SR, n_fft=2048)
        return SpectrogramCepstrum(SR, n_fft=2048), stft._process(x)
    if name == "noct_synthesis":
        # The synthesis kernel accepts one-sided spectral rows.
        return NOctSynthesis(SR, fmin=100.0, fmax=10_000.0, n=3), np.abs(np.fft.rfft(x, axis=-1))
    if name == "fix_length":
        return FixLength(SR, length=n + 4096), x
    if name == "fade":
        return Fade(SR, fade_ms=50), x
    if name == "loudness_zwtv":
        return LoudnessZwtv(SR), x
    if name == "roughness_dw":
        return RoughnessDw(SR), x
    if name == "sharpness_din":
        return SharpnessDin(SR), x
    raise KeyError(name)


def graphs(operation: Any, values: np.ndarray) -> tuple[Any, Any]:
    source = da.from_array(values, chunks=(1, *values.shape[1:]))
    shape = operation.calculate_output_shape(source.shape)
    dtype = operation.calculate_output_dtype(source.dtype)
    whole = operation._build_whole_frame_graph(source, (), output_shape=shape, output_dtype=dtype)
    candidate = _try_build_channelwise_graph(
        operation, source, (), output_shape=shape, output_dtype=dtype
    )
    if candidate is None:
        raise RuntimeError(f"candidate helper rejected {operation.name}")
    return whole, candidate


def digest(value: np.ndarray) -> str:
    contiguous = np.ascontiguousarray(value)
    return hashlib.sha256(contiguous.view(np.uint8)).hexdigest()


def materialize(graph: Any, boundary: str) -> np.ndarray:
    if boundary == "operation":
        return np.asarray(graph.compute())
    # Exercise the exact normal Frame materialization implementation without
    # constructing domain-specific metadata wrappers for every rank transition.
    holder = SimpleNamespace(_effective_data=graph)
    return np.asarray(BaseFrame._compute(holder))


def worker(args: argparse.Namespace) -> dict[str, Any]:
    operation, values = make_case(
        args.operation,
        args.channels,
        args.dtype,
        performance=args.mode == "measure",
        average=args.average,
        detrend=args.detrend,
    )
    whole, candidate = graphs(operation, values)
    if args.mode == "parity":
        left = np.asarray(whole.compute(scheduler="synchronous"))
        right = np.asarray(candidate.compute(scheduler="synchronous"))
        exact = np.array_equal(left, right)
        max_abs = float(np.max(np.abs(left - right))) if left.size and right.size else 0.0
        return {
            "mode": "parity", "operation": args.operation, "channels": args.channels,
            "input_dtype": args.dtype, "input_shape": list(values.shape),
            "average": args.average if args.operation == "welch" else None,
            "detrend": args.detrend if args.operation == "welch" else None,
            "whole_shape": list(left.shape), "candidate_shape": list(right.shape),
            "whole_dtype": str(left.dtype), "candidate_dtype": str(right.dtype),
            "whole_checksum": digest(left), "candidate_checksum": digest(right),
            "exact": exact, "max_abs_difference": max_abs,
        }
    graph = whole if args.path == "whole" else candidate
    tracemalloc.start()
    build_start = time.perf_counter_ns()
    # Graphs are intentionally built before timing in this worker; report a
    # deterministic rebuild using the same operation and source.
    rebuilt = graphs(operation, values)[0 if args.path == "whole" else 1]
    build_ns = time.perf_counter_ns() - build_start
    _, build_peak = tracemalloc.get_traced_memory()
    tracemalloc.stop()
    started = time.perf_counter_ns()
    out = materialize(rebuilt, args.boundary)
    materialize_ns = time.perf_counter_ns() - started
    rss = resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss
    rss_bytes = int(rss * 1024 if sys.platform != "darwin" else rss)
    return {
        "mode": "measure", "operation": args.operation, "channels": args.channels,
        "input_dtype": args.dtype, "path": args.path, "boundary": args.boundary,
        "run_index": args.run_index, "input_shape": list(values.shape),
        "input_bytes": int(values.nbytes), "output_shape": list(out.shape),
        "output_dtype": str(out.dtype), "output_bytes": int(out.nbytes),
        "checksum": digest(out), "tasks": len(rebuilt.__dask_graph__()),
        "graph_build_ns": build_ns, "graph_build_peak_python_bytes": int(build_peak),
        "materialization_ns": materialize_ns, "peak_rss_bytes": rss_bytes,
    }


def invoke(script: Path, argv: list[str]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    env = os.environ.copy()
    env["PYTHONPATH"] = f"{Path.cwd()}{os.pathsep}{env.get('PYTHONPATH', '')}"
    proc = subprocess.run(
        [sys.executable, str(script), "--worker", *argv],
        check=True, capture_output=True, text=True, env=env,
    )
    return json.loads(proc.stdout)


def orchestrate(args: argparse.Namespace) -> None:
    script = Path(__file__).resolve()
    clean_command = ["git", "status", "--porcelain", "--untracked-files=all"]
    clean_stdout = subprocess.check_output(clean_command, text=True)
    if clean_stdout:
        raise RuntimeError(f"benchmark requires a clean worktree, got:\n{clean_stdout}")
    observations: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    for name in OPS:
        for channels in (1, 2, 4, 8):
            for dtype in ("float32", "float64"):
                observations.append(invoke(script, [
                    "--mode", "parity", "--operation", name,
                    "--channels", str(channels), "--dtype", dtype,
                ]))
        for channels in (4, 8):
            for boundary in ("operation", "frame_data"):
                counters = {"whole": 0, "candidate": 0}
                for path in RUN_ORDER:
                    counters[path] += 1
                    observations.append(invoke(script, [
                        "--mode", "measure", "--operation", name,
                        "--channels", str(channels), "--dtype", "float64",
                        "--path", path, "--boundary", boundary,
                        "--run-index", str(counters[path]),
                    ]))
    for average, detrend in WELCH_CONFIGS:
        for channels in (1, 2, 4, 8):
            for dtype in ("float32", "float64"):
                observations.append(invoke(script, [
                    "--mode", "parity", "--operation", "welch",
                    "--channels", str(channels), "--dtype", dtype,
                    "--average", average, "--detrend", detrend,
                ]))
    lock = Path("uv.lock").read_bytes()
    source = script.read_text()
    report = {
        "schema_version": 1,
        "purpose": "PR #360 formal channel-wise D-candidate decision evidence",
        "base_sha": subprocess.check_output(["git", "rev-parse", "origin/main"], text=True).strip(),
        "candidate_sha": subprocess.check_output(["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"], text=True).strip(),
        "working_tree_clean_before_benchmark": subprocess.call(["git", "diff", "--quiet"]) == 0,
        "pre_benchmark_clean_state": {
            "command": clean_command,
            "stdout": clean_stdout,
        },
        "lock_sha256": hashlib.sha256(lock).hexdigest(),
        "script_sha256": hashlib.sha256(source.encode()).hexdigest(),
        "worker_source": source,
        "orchestrator_source": source,
        "environment": {
            "platform": platform.platform(), "python": sys.version,
            "numpy": np.__version__, "dask": __import__("dask").__version__,
            "scheduler": "default threaded for measurements; synchronous only for parity",
            "native_thread_overrides": {},
        },
        "commands": {
            "orchestrator": [sys.executable, str(script), "--output", args.output],
            "worker_template": [sys.executable, str(script), "--worker", "..."],
        },
        "run_order": list(RUN_ORDER),
        "operations": list(OPS),
        "welch_configs": [list(config) for config in WELCH_CONFIGS],
        "observations": observations,
    }
    Path(args.output).write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + "\n")


def parse() -> argparse.Namespace:
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    p.add_argument("--worker", action="store_true")
    p.add_argument("--mode", choices=("parity", "measure"), default="parity")
    p.add_argument("--operation", choices=(*OPS, "welch"))
    p.add_argument("--channels", type=int, default=1)
    p.add_argument("--dtype", default="float64")
    p.add_argument("--path", choices=("whole", "candidate"), default="whole")
    p.add_argument("--boundary", choices=("operation", "frame_data"), default="operation")
    p.add_argument("--run-index", type=int, default=1)
    p.add_argument("--average", choices=("mean", "median"), default="mean")
    p.add_argument("--detrend", choices=("constant", "linear"), default="constant")
    p.add_argument("--output", default="/tmp/channelwise-decision-evidence.json")
    return p.parse_args()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parsed = parse()
    if parsed.worker:
        # Optional libraries may print advisory warnings to stdout; keep the
        # worker protocol as exactly one JSON document.
        with contextlib.redirect_stdout(io.StringIO()):
            result = worker(parsed)
        print(json.dumps(result))
    else:
        orchestrate(parsed)

        orchestrate(parsed)
